493 likes, 26 comments - ramit on October 12, 2026: "If you’ve known something for years and changed nothing, more information isn’t the answer.

This couple knows spending 154% of their take-home pay on fixed costs isn’t sustainable, yet they spent $111 on Ubers in a single day for the convenience. The real issue is their invisible scripts: the deeply held beliefs about money that drive your choices without you even noticing.

Comment MINDSET and I’ll send you my free Money Mindset Mini Course to help you spot the invisible scripts behind your spending, so you can finally change what you do, not just what you know.

▶️ Watch and listen to “Money For Couples” on Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.".
